description: NaNb₂PS₁₀ is Zircon-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaNb₂PS₁₀ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.35 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to eight S atoms to form NbS₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share  an edgeedge with one PS₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NbS₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Nb-S bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.68 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to eight S atoms to form distorted NbS₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share  an edgeedge with one PS₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NbS₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Nb-S bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.68 Å. P is bonded to four S atoms to form PS₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two NbS₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.09 Å. There are ten inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Nb and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.05 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Nb and one P atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Nb and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.03 Å. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Nb and one S atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Nb, and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.04 Å. In the seventh S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Nb, and one S atom. In the eighth S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one P atom. In the ninth S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the tenth S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Nb and one S atom.
